# google_licensemanager_license_configuration

A configuration to purchase licenses for a single third-party product. License Configurations are
unique per project and region.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](https://terraform.io/docs/providers/google/guides/provider_versions.html) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about LicenseConfiguration, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/licensemanager/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.configurations)
* How-to Guides
    * [About License Manager](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instances/windows/license-manager)
    * [Use License Manager for Microsoft Office](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instances/windows/ms-office)

## Example Usage - Licensemanager License Configuration Basic


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {
    provider = google-beta
}

resource "google_licensemanager_license_configuration" "example" {
    provider = google-beta
    location = "australia-southeast1"
    product = "Office2021ProfessionalPlus"
    project = data.google_project.project.project_id
    license_configuration_name = "lima_config"
    display_name = "lima-configdisplay-name"
    current_billing_info {
        user_count_billing { user_count = 10 }
    }
    next_billing_info {
        user_count_billing { user_count = 10 }
    }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `product` -
  (Required)
  The product code that this configuration is licensing.

* `display_name` -
  (Required)

* `next_billing_info` -
  (Required)
  Billing info for the current month (important for creation).
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_next_billing_info).

* `current_billing_info` -
  (Required)
  Billing info for the current month (important for creation).
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_current_billing_info).

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The region for which the licenses are provisioned.

* `license_configuration_name` -
  (Required)
  The name to identify the license configuration.


<a name="nested_next_billing_info"></a>The `next_billing_info` block supports:

* `user_count_billing` -
  (Required)
  A nested object resource.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_next_billing_info_user_count_billing).


<a name="nested_next_billing_info_user_count_billing"></a>The `user_count_billing` block supports:

* `user_count` -
  (Required)

<a name="nested_current_billing_info"></a>The `current_billing_info` block supports:

* `user_count_billing` -
  (Required)
  A nested object resource.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_current_billing_info_user_count_billing).


<a name="nested_current_billing_info_user_count_billing"></a>The `user_count_billing` block supports:

* `user_count` -
  (Required)

- - -


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/configurations/{{license_configuration_name}}`


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


LicenseConfiguration can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/configurations/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{name}}`
* `{{location}}/{{name}}`


In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import LicenseConfiguration using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/configurations/{{name}}"
  to = google_licensemanager_license_configuration.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), LicenseConfiguration can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_licensemanager_license_configuration.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/configurations/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_licensemanager_license_configuration.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_licensemanager_license_configuration.default {{location}}/{{name}}
```
